title: rosa gallica proles cordata
intro: Rosa gallica proles cordata, commonly known as the Red Damask Rose, is a species of rose that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its fragrant flowers, which have been used in traditional medicine for centuries to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Rosa gallica proles cordata include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
